column2: I see!
Then this is the final question.
M-my daddy's... my daddy's killer!!
H-hey! Hold it!! Who the hell are you people?!
They are the families of those
nameless $$兵士達$$ you killed so carelessly.
Whatever good or evil those men held as soldiers,
they had families too.
When you kill someone, someone else will always come to hate you.
Their desire for revenge is the only natural consequence of your actions thus far!!
Tch!
While fighting, have you ever once considered the people they leave behind?
Y-you bastard!
You planned to lure us into this trap from the start!
For what it's worth, they will keep pursuing you to the ends of the earth...
Even if you run or try to deceive them, there will be no resolution.
Hey, what the hell are we supposed to do?!
Fight them!
Try to escape.
Let them kill us?
Maybe that can't be helped.
True... that is one possible truth.

Either way, we must all break through here!
